stdin.meaning: Raw JSON object on a declared stdin stream, not the nested staff payload. Duplicate keys and non-JSON constants are refused. No arguments are accepted.

name.meaning: Registry and vault name; lookup is case-insensitive and cannot replace a built-in or foreign entry.

about.meaning: Public description; excludes Unicode Cc and Cs. Neither name nor about may contain the submitted value.

value.meaning: Custody value read only from the stream, never reflected into the receipt or public metadata.

mutationPerformed.meaning: Custody write outcome; can precede the registry write and can be unknown.

name.meaning: Safe registry name; existing owned entries retain their canonical case.

about.meaning: Safe public description, omitted from the value entirely.

replaced.meaning: A matching registry entry or owned key already existed at preflight.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The outer stop prefixes its own refusals and the validated custody-child tail; a sensitive tail is replaced by a fixed refusal.
